text:
Clara: dropped a tiny prototype for showing variant preview thumbnails on the version timeline. idea: hover a snapshot marker -> show a 120x80 preview of the UI and meta (commit, author). figma: https://www.figma.com/file/variant/thumbs-proto

Marta: neat. previews help non-dev PMs pick the right snapshot. question: are previews server-generated screenshots or client-rendered diffs?

Noah: plan is server-generated thumbnails on snapshot creation to avoid client photo rendering. they'll be cached and served via CDN.

Alex (A11y): accessibility flags: 1) thumbnails are visual only — always include descriptive alt text: e.g., "Snapshot March 12 2026 by Clara: canary 10% - login flow". 2) when thumbnail opens on hover, ensure keyboard focus can open it via Enter and that focus moves into a small dialog with role=dialog.

Clara: good call. also thinking of a compact mode where the thumbnail becomes an inline mini-card on focus so it's discoverable by keyboard and touch.

Marta: microcopy for the preview CTA: "Compare snapshot" vs "Open preview". prefer "Compare snapshot" since side-by-side is common.

Noah: mobile behaviour: tooltips on hover won't work. on touch we should tap once to show the preview card, tap again to open detailed view. long-press reserved for context menu.

Alex (A11y): for screen readers announce: "Snapshot preview available. Press Enter to open." Use `aria-describedby` linking to the alt text. If multiple thumbnails load slowly, announce loading state: "Snapshot preview loading" using a polite live region.

Clara: performance note: lazy-load thumbnails for offscreen markers and show a skeleton card while loading.

Marta: contrast/visibility: thumbnails need a 2px ring on focus and a clear background so they don't blend into timeline. avoid relying on color alone to indicate selected snapshot.

Alex (A11y): ensure keyboard target meets 44x44px. add an option to view a text-only snapshot summary list for SR users (date, author, short message). We should document keyboard shortcuts: `Shift+S` to open snapshot list when timeline is focused.

Noah: backend will add alt text to snapshot metadata and CDN will support a small/large variant for detail view.

Clara: added microcopy: preview card header: "Snapshot Mar 12 — Clara" body: "Canary 10% — login flow" CTA: "Compare snapshot". will update figma and include keyboard state.

deploy-bot: preview uploaded for feat/variant-thumbs -> https://preview.redwood.dev/variant-thumbs (expires in 24h)
